# SurfaceGuard 0.5.2

SurfaceGuard 0.5.2 is a packaging-integrity patch. The GitHub release archive now
includes the policy reference, threat model, and roadmap linked from its README, so all
relative documentation links work in an installed package without repository access.

The clean-install release gate now checks every relative README target in the packed and
installed artifact to prevent this defect from recurring.

Route-policy validation now rejects an empty allow list instead of treating it as no
allow-list control. The generic adapter recognizes direct string entries in a `routes`
array while continuing to ignore unrelated manifest strings.

Sitemap reconciliation now distinguishes page locations from child-sitemap references
and extension namespace locations, and framework-owned Astro and Next.js error documents
are no longer required in sitemaps.

Release verification and packaging now run in a read-only job without persisted Git
credentials. A separate publish-only job receives the verified files, and dispatches
must come from the protected main workflow and resolve an exact annotated semantic-version
tag at the current main commit with the generic public tagger identity and exact
attribution-free message. Draft creation and asset upload are restart-safe: publication
requires one exact archive whose remote size and SHA-256 digest match the verified local
file. A rerun resumes an exact incomplete draft, while any unexpected draft or published
state fails closed without automatic deletion. Organization policy enforces immutable
releases for the repository.

The attached package is for direct GitHub installation. This release is not published to
npm or another package registry.
